instruction: Compare several metrics for one/few entities radially.

dimensions.names: provide dimension names as JSON array, min 1 max 1

measures: provide measure names separated by comma, min 2 max any

color.description: Solid hex string or palette array of hex colors

instructions: Fill ChartSettings only (JSON). Do NOT invent JS/JSX or component props.
dimensions.names and measures must be real result-column names from data_types / sample_row (JSON arrays).
dimensions.names[0] = axis category; measures = 2+ numeric spokes.
Set labelsX, labelsY to user-friendly axis titles (aliases OK; need not equal column names).
color: solid hex string or palette array when the template asks; omit if unused.
Do NOT return measure_formats here — formats are a separate step.
